description: Fix a latest-versions list that sorts version strings as text. DISTILL-CANARY-c566f6da

files.README.md: releases.txt lists released versions, one per line, in no particular order.
files.latest_versions.py:
with open("releases.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    versions = [line.strip() for line in f if line.strip()]
versions.sort(reverse=True)
for version in versions[:3]:
    print(version)
